ignoreValues.reason: FAQ ::details-content height transition is the platform-sanctioned details animation (interpolate-size); grid-rows trick cannot work on native details. Deon-approved.
Ember-dust dot field is the deliberately harvested brand device (dust in candlelight), not a grid overlay. Deon-approved on the landing page and again when it moved into the shared app component.

Candlelight IS the brand, not a chromatic halo for its own sake. The product is called Everlit and the headline is 'Keep their light lit'; DESIGN.md defines the mood as 'Candlelit vigil' with goldWarm #C49A6C as the workhorse accent, and already uses glow as house language elsewhere (drop-shadow 0 0 40px on the phone mock, HorizonGlow on the gates). The flagged CTA shadow is also not a zero-offset halo: it carries a real 6px y-offset plus a separate black elevation shadow, so it reads as a lit object on a surface. Commissioned by Deon 2026-07-26 (see the comment above .hero-btn) when the CTA was upgraded from a flat cream pill into the page's own light.
